scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,magenta "uv run --directory backend uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.test: uv run --directory backend pytest -v && npm --prefix frontend test
scripts.lint: uv run --directory backend ruff check app tests && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
